reference.title: Publishing Commands
reference.shortdesc: Commands for publishing DITA content to HTML5, PDF, and other output formats.

section.title: DITA: Publish (Select Format)
section.p: Opens a format selection dialog and publishes the current DITA map or topic.

ul.li: html5 - Modern HTML5 output with responsive design
pdf - PDF output (requires Apache FOP or similar)
DITA-OT must be installed and configured

section.title: DITA: Publish to HTML5
section.p: Quickly publishes the current file to HTML5 format without format selection.

ol.li: Run the command from Command Palette
Output is generated in the out folder

section.p: By default, output is generated in {workspace}/out/{format}. You can customize this in settings with ditacraft.outputDirectory.

section.title: DITA: Preview HTML5
section.p: Opens a live HTML5 preview panel alongside the editor.

ul.li: Live Updates: Preview refreshes automatically as you type
Scroll Sync: Bidirectional scroll synchronization between editor and preview
Theme Support: Light and dark theme support
Conref Resolution: Displays resolved conref content

section.note: The preview uses a lightweight renderer that does not require DITA-OT, making it instant for quick content review.

section.title: DITA: Manage Publishing Profiles
section.p: Create, edit, delete, or select a saved publish configuration — transtype, output directory, DITAVAL filter, and extra DITA-OT arguments — instead of re-entering the same options on every publish. See for the full field reference.

section.title: DITA: Start Watch Mode / DITA: Stop Watch Mode
section.p: Starts (or stops) automatically re-running a full publish whenever a watched DITA file changes, using the last-used publishing profile when one exists. See for target-resolution order and status bar behavior.

section.title: DITA: Install DITA-OT
section.p: Downloads a DITA-OT release from GitHub, extracts it into a folder, verifies it and sets ditacraft.ditaOtPath to the new installation.

ol.li: Pick a version. The preferred version from ditacraft.ditaOtPreferredVersion is preselected; otherwise the latest release is.
Pick the install folder, or use ditacraft.ditaOtInstallTargetDir if it is set.
Confirm the install. The archive is extracted to a staging folder, verified with dita --version, then moved to dita-ot-<version>.

section.p: If verification fails, the staging folder is removed and the path setting is not changed. If GitHub cannot be reached, a built-in list of versions is shown.

section.title: DITA: Manage DITA-OT Plugins
section.p: Lists the plugins installed in the configured DITA-OT (dita plugins), with their versions, in a picker, and installs plugins from the DITA-OT plugin registry (dita install <id>[@version]).
Plugin installation runs code from the registry. Output is shown in the DITA-OT output panel. The registry URL is set with ditacraft.ditaOtRegistryUrl and must use https.

Known limitations: uninstalling and updating plugins are not available yet; use the dita command line for those. Editing the registry list is not supported; only the registry URL can be changed. If the registry catalog cannot be loaded, DITA Craft falls back to the file listing of the dita-ot/registry repository on GitHub, which shows plugin IDs without version information.

section.title: DITA: Configure DITA-OT Path
section.p: Opens a folder picker to select your DITA-OT installation directory.

ol.li: Install DITA-OT with DITA: Install DITA-OT, or download it from dita-ot.org and extract it to a location on your system
Run this command and select the DITA-OT directory

section.p: After configuration, DITA Craft verifies the installation by checking for:

ul.li: lib/ directory with required JAR files

section.title: Common Publishing Errors
section.p: If publishing fails, check the following:

dlentry.dd: Run DITA: Configure DITA-OT Path to set the correct path.
Install JRE 11+ and ensure JAVA_HOME is set correctly.
Check the Output panel for detailed error messages from DITA-OT.
